evidence.title: When Test-Time Adaptation Helps, Harms, or Becomes Inactive: A Condition-Level Study on CIFAR-10-C

summary: Researchers analyze how test-time adaptation techniques impact AI model performance under varying conditions using the CIFAR-10-C dataset. Findings reveal scenarios where adaptation improves accuracy, degrades it, or has no effect.
title: Study Examines Conditions Where Test-Time Adaptation Aids, Harms, or Fails in AI Models
